$comment: Seconds each browser test file runs in one of CI's docs browser jobs (4 cores, the files several at a time, so the time a file takes beside others): what packages/tools/src/run-node-tests.js splits the files into TEST_SHARD's shares by (`--shard-weights`, apps/docs/package.json's test:browser), longest first, each to the share with the least so far. A file not named here weighs the median of these, and the log of its job says so. A name of a file that is not here is ignored. Seeded from CI runs 40025710312 (main, 2026-10-23) and 40320659523 (2026-10-26, with three files then on their way to main): the sum of each file's top-level tests' durations, the mean of the two runs where a file ran in both. To measure them again: every job sharded by these weights prints `# file-duration <file> <seconds>` (the duration of the file's own run) at the end of its log; save the logs of a run's three jobs (`gh run view <run> --job <job> --log > shard-N.log`) and run `node packages/tools/src/shard-weights.js apps/docs/test/browser/durations.json shard-1.log shard-2.log shard-3.log`.
